summary: DAEDALUS follow-through materially narrows the historical-time-quality risk: inspected LearningFabric, API, Adaptive Brain, APEX and UI paths do not promote UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE historical experiences into runtime configuration, model qualification, production authority or execution. The remaining operator-risk is projection semantics: count-only MEASURED and LEARNING labels survive without time_quality, while APEX marks a structurally readable learning snapshot AVAILABLE. AION's later BTC state history independently confirms the same integration rule: an observed state transition is durable memory, not predictive authority. Containment prevents promotion; it does not make the projected label scientifically qualified.
accepted_findings: DAEDALUS: runtime-configuration scorecards admit only RUNTIME_CLOSURE_CONFIG/CLOSURE_TIME_CONFIG; historical artifacts remain provenance-partitioned.
DAEDALUS: inspected authenticated API, Adaptive Brain, APEX kernel and UI paths do not derive model credibility, production authority or execution from timezone-unverified historical experience.
AION: the BTC episode moved from joint range-volume expansion to range-only volatility and then normalization; this is valid causal-state memory and negative evidence against persistence.
FLOW: the 09:00 UTC range burst is cross-provider price-range corroboration only; the 11:00 UTC bar normalized and no order-flow or persistent-liquidity claim was made.
MACRO: the source-reported steady November OPEC+ target was expected, lacked final official confirmation at retrieval, and produced no material state transition.

INFRASTRUCTURE: Flow 12:35 UTC now has an exact canonical native receipt, but its heartbeat had already been watchdog-recovered before the native receipt appeared, so final provenance is MISSED_THEN_LATE_NATIVE rather than on-time healthy.
rejected_findings: Reject MEASURED, LEARNING or APEX AVAILABLE as shorthand for timezone-qualified, causally learned, scientifically tested or execution-ready evidence.
Reject downstream containment as proof that aggregate/API/UI semantics are correct.
Reject the one BTC episode as a calibrated precursor, persistent regime, directional order-flow mechanism or tradable edge.
Reject the Flow watchdog-bound heartbeat as proof of on-time native completion; the later exact receipt preserves a late-recovery transition.
Reject GitHub-native v3 deterministic_liveness receipts as substantive specialist inference; current DAEDALUS v3 explicitly records SUBSTANTIVE_AI_INFERENCE_NOT_EXECUTED.
conflicts: Historical records remain safely excluded from runtime configuration while aggregate cards omit time_quality and can still display MEASURED.
The learner can report LEARNING from experience count even though the same records are outcome memory rather than forecast accuracy.
APEX can mark a structurally readable snapshot AVAILABLE without inspecting temporal quality, although its kernel does not promote the snapshot into model credibility.
Flow 12:35 UTC has exact worker receipt verification, but its heartbeat was watchdog-bound eight minutes before native verification; durability and exact-native timing are distinct.
AION's immutable state history improves causal memory while effective-N, multiplicity, ablation, OOS and cost gates remain unmet.
blockers: time_quality and time_interpretation are not propagated through generic/historical aggregate cards or all API/UI projections.
APEX lacks an AVAILABLE_DEGRADED_EVIDENCE state keyed to temporal/scientific authority.
No end-to-end live API/UI regression has verified preservation of UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE across /api/learning, /api/learning/experience and future Brain projections.
DAEDALUS performed repository-level inspection only; no tests or deployed runtime were executed in that cycle.
The BTC anomaly sequence remains one adaptively selected episode with a small serially dependent baseline, unresolved multiplicity and no protected OOS evidence.

Restored-five remains heterogeneous: Alpha 12:25 and Advanced CSV 12:15 are exact verified, Flow 12:35 is missed-then-late-native, Robustness 12:05 is missing/watchdog-only, and Apex 12:45 had not reached an adjudicated post-grace state in the inspected evidence.
